reasons: CS4240 and CS4249 both need CS3240, which needs CS2111. CS2111 is Sem 2 only; with LOA in semester 4 and exchange in semester 8, it can only be taken in semester 6.
CS3240 is Sem 1 only, so it would fall in semester 7, leaving CS4240 and CS4249 (Sem 2 only) for semester 8, which is the exchange semester.
Therefore the required courses cannot all be completed by semester 8.
